subject.title: Require Codex scan artifact coverage proof

question: Should ClawHub permanently require complete worker-reported artifact coverage before any benign Codex result can become a clean authoritative scan?
rationale: This deliberately trades compatibility and scan completion availability for stronger assurance at the authoritative clean-verdict boundary, which is a security and operations policy choice rather than a mechanical repair.

options.title: Adopt strict coverage
options.body: Resolve the conflicts, repeat the worker proof, and require complete coverage for every benign clean verdict.

options.title: Stage enforcement
options.body: First record coverage telemetry or warnings, then enable fail-closed enforcement after confirming worker output compatibility.

options.title: Keep current contract
options.body: Decline the stricter requirement and continue allowing benign worker results without explicit per-file coverage evidence.

recommendation.title: Adopt strict coverage
recommendation.body: Resolve the conflicts, repeat the worker proof, and require complete coverage for every benign clean verdict.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest available implementation and adjacent-path context, though final security-policy acceptance may require another repository decision-maker.
